role: Looks up the checked English language keys used by the engine in a table generated from the user's 1.7.10 client jar.
gpu: lang_text scans a generated pointer table; callers in the tick use only checked keys and do not allocate
notes: The table header is generated in out/native by tools/langgen.c from assets/minecraft/lang/en_US.lang in the user's jar. Unknown keys abort, so the checked key list is the engine's complete domain.
